pages.title: Checkmate Rewind
pages.creator: vlaber
pages.description:
Checkmate Rewind turns a completed chess position into a puzzle you solve backward. Undo moves, restore captured pieces, and reverse special actions such as castling, en passant, and pawn promotion. Each case requires you to reconstruct the starting position within an exact move allowance.

Eight introductory lessons explain how the backward moves work before you tackle fifty-five handcrafted cases. The puzzles range from brief mistakes to recognizable opening traps. A daily case drawn from a real Lichess game adds another position to investigate. The challenge is to identify a valid history for the board rather than choose the next attacking move.

pages.title: Dreamland Survivors
pages.creator: Zadzi
pages.description: Keep moving through monster hordes in Dreamland Survivors while your weapons fire automatically. Gather experience and choose upgrades to build up your hero before the boss appears at the ten-minute mark. Beat it and take the portal to carry your build into the next land. Silver from each run buys lasting upgrades and unlocks.

pages.title: Crazy Chess: Forest Adventure
pages.creator: 9five
pages.description: Move chess-inspired units across a fantasy board in Crazy Chess: Forest Adventure. Attacks affect health, and special abilities and power-ups give you more to consider than where a piece can move. Take down the opposing boss in a match against a friend or challenge the computer at different difficulties.

pages.title: Guns & Bottles
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: The gun and the targets both rotate in Guns & Bottles. Tap when the barrel lines up with a bottle, but let the red bottles go by, since hitting one ends the round. Collect coins to unlock other guns while you work on your timing.

pages.title: SUGAR POP LAND
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Swap sweets to line up three or more in SUGAR POP LAND. A line of four or more creates a special sweet, and combining special pieces can clear more of the board. Check which sweets the current stage asks for and aim your matches at those targets.

pages.title: Panda Dash Auto Shooting
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guide a panda warrior through side-scrolling arenas in Panda Dash Auto Shooting. Let the automatic shooting handle the attacks while you look for a position that keeps the panda out of the zombie crowd. The waves get tougher as you go, so keep moving when the current spot starts to close in.

pages.title: Dark Myth: Monkey Merge
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Build an army for the Monkey King in Dark Myth: Monkey Merge. Combine warriors to raise their rank, then send the stronger lineup against waves of monsters. Keep improving the force as you fight to free the Monkey King's captured master and companions.

pages.title: Magic Beauty Makeup
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Take a makeover appointment from skin care to makeup in Magic Beauty Makeup. Click and drag to apply treatments, then work on the client's facial makeup. Choose colors and details that work together as you finish the look in the salon.

pages.title: Swap Color
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Change your shape's color in Swap Color to match each obstacle coming toward it. Watch the next color and time your tap so you switch before the shape reaches the barrier. Keep the matches going as the pace picks up.

pages.title: Cubes 2048.io
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Steer a snake made of numbered cubes in Cubes 2048.io. Collect cubes around the map and merge equal values to grow the snake. Watch where opponents are headed while you look for the numbers you need to work your way up to 2048.

pages.title: World War 2 Shooter
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Fight enemy soldiers in World War 2 Shooter, a first-person game set on World War II battlefields. Switch weapons as the fight changes and use grenades when you need to attack beyond your current line of fire. Keep a first aid kit in mind when your health runs low.

pages.title: Brainrot Merge Drop Puzzles
pages.creator: Affrica
pages.description: Drop meme characters into a pile in Brainrot Merge Drop Puzzles. When two of the same kind meet, they merge and make room for another drop. Work out where to place characters such as Trallallero Trallala or Boneca Ambalabu so matching pieces can meet.

pages.title: Superhero Transform Change Race
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Switch forms to get through the course in Superhero Transform Change Race. Choose Spider-Man to climb rock, a shark to get across water, or the Flash to sprint. Read the next obstacle early so you can transform in time and keep ahead of the other racers.

pages.title: BOMBAMAN 3D
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Place bombs to clear paths and defeat monsters in BOMBAMAN 3D. Nearby bombs can set one another off, so give yourself room to get clear. Look for a hidden exit before time runs out, and collect clocks or upgrades that increase your bombs' range. Play alone or with a friend.

pages.title: Idle Casino Manager Tycoon
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Start with a small casino in Idle Casino Manager Tycoon and use its earnings to expand the business. Upgrade the facilities and build more floors so the casino brings in more idle income. Decide what to improve first as the operation grows.

pages.title: Golden Frontier
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Build up a Wild West settlement in Golden Frontier. Mine resources, grow crops, and turn materials into crafted goods while looking for gold. Follow the story to unlock places and meet more people, or invite neighbors to trade and work together.

pages.title: Grand Clash Arena
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Fight opponents in Grand Clash Arena and use the objects you find around the arena. Weapons can drop from above during a battle, so watch for new equipment and change your approach when it lands. Decide when to go for a drop and when to stay on your opponent.

pages.title: Impostor Hook Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Throw hooks at opponents across the arena in Impostor Hook Master. Aim to pull enemies to your side while avoiding the hooks they send back. Watch where a target is moving before you throw so you can catch them when they cross the line of your hook.

pages.title: Cosmo Pet Starry Care
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Pick an alien companion in Cosmo Pet Starry Care. Feed your pet, take it for walks, and play with it as you find out what it needs. Try the different care activities as you get to know your space friend.

pages.title: Skibidi StickBloons
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Pop every balloon in Skibidi StickBloons. Aim and shoot from the Skibidi character's position, taking a moment to check where the balloons sit before firing. Each arena changes the layout, so adjust your aim when a shot that worked before will miss the next group.

pages.title: Fresh Spring Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help the friends dress for spring in Fresh Spring Style. Browse a wardrobe filled with floral and blossom prints, then pick outfits for the season. Try different colors and accessories to give each friend a look that suits her.

pages.title: Extreme Blur Race
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Race the computer or a friend in Extreme Blur Race. Steer around the course and pick up power-ups that can give you a burst of speed or slow down a rival. Use the respawn control to get back into the race if your car gets stuck.

pages.title: Mahjong Tiles Christmas
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pair up identical winter tiles in Mahjong Tiles Christmas. A tile needs an open left or right side before you can select it. Clear a pair to make more tiles accessible, then keep going until the board is empty and the next level is ready.

pages.title: Dirt Bike MotoCross
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Lean and accelerate over uneven ground in Dirt Bike MotoCross. Race against other riders and adjust the bike's angle when you tackle obstacles or steep climbs. Try to finish first across 15 tracks, with races for groups of two, four, or six riders.

pages.title: Fruit Lines Saga
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Move fruit to empty cells in Fruit Lines Saga and line up five or more of the same kind. Rows, columns, and diagonals all count. Use the hammer, bomb, or undo when space gets tight, and visit the Lucky Wheel for bonus items.

pages.title: Fighter Manager
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Run a fight club in Fighter Manager. Hire fighters and coaches, then build a plan around your fighter's strengths and the opponent's weaknesses. Use cards during play and work toward winning tournaments as you build up the team.

pages.title: Mr Noob Hook Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Swing from anchor to anchor in Mr Noob Hook Hero. Time when you hook on and let go so Noob can move past hazards and reach the next anchor. Watch for the Pro, who can knock him down if he is spotted before the finish.

pages.title: Foxy Golf Royale
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Play through 3D courses in Foxy Golf Royale. Line up the ball and adjust the strength of your shot to account for where it needs to land. Watch how the ball rolls after it touches down so you can plan the next stroke.

pages.title: Paper Fold Origami
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Tap the paper flaps in Paper Fold Origami to reveal a picture. The folding order decides which parts of the image end up on top. Look at the visible edges and change your sequence when one fold covers a detail you still need.

pages.title: Real Car Pro Racing
pages.description: Race sports cars around city tracks in Real Car Pro Racing. Place in the top three to open the next event, using nitro when you need to make up ground. Buy or upgrade cars as you work through the 36 tracks and face tougher opponents.

pages.title: Snaklaus
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Steer through a field of presents in Snaklaus and collect as many as you can to build your score. Use the arrow keys or on-screen controls to change direction. Pick Classic or Hard mode depending on the challenge you want for the next run.

pages.title: Neon Tetrix
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Rotate and drop falling blocks in Neon Tetrix to fill horizontal rows. Completed rows disappear and earn points, while consecutive clears can build a combo. Watch the gaps you leave behind and use the swap control when a different piece would fit better.

pages.title: Archers.io
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gather gray stragglers in Archers.io and turn them into a growing team of archers. Move around the field to recruit more members as other groups build up their own forces. Choose where to steer based on who you can recruit and which groups you might meet.

pages.title: Fun Draw Race 3D
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Draw legs for a racing robot in Fun Draw Race 3D. Try a shape that can carry the robot over the first obstacle, then redraw it when the track demands something different. Change the legs mid-race if the current shape keeps getting stuck.

pages.title: Jumpero
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Leap over high walls in Jumpero. Watch the next barrier as you approach and time the jump so the character clears it. Pay attention to where you land so you can set up the following leap.

pages.title: Grand Zombie Swarm
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Play a special forces soldier fighting zombies in Grand Zombie Swarm. Move through an open area and use different weapons to survive each level's horde. Aim before firing, swap weapons when you need to, and give yourself room to reload.

pages.title: Shoot The Balloon
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Hold the mouse button or touch the screen to shoot incoming balloons in Shoot The Balloon. Clear the waves to earn money for the shop. Choose from six characters and six weapons as you put together a setup for the next round.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Choose a picture and a difficulty in Jigsaw Puzzle, then fit the pieces together. The scenes feature animals, unfamiliar places, and other subjects. Look for details such as an outline or a change in color to tell which pieces belong beside one another.

pages.title: Alien Invaders.io
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Pilot a UFO in Alien Invaders.io and abduct objects to grow. Pick Classic to aim for the biggest ship, Solo to consume the city, or Battle to try to be the last UFO left. Watch for boosters such as a magnet or an upsize pickup while you move.

pages.title: Love and Treasure Quest
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Help a knight reach the treasure and rescue the princess in Love and Treasure Quest. Pull pins and cut ropes in an order that keeps the knight safe and the treasure intact. Work out how spikes, boulders, and poison gas will move before you open the next passage.

pages.title: Candy Connection
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Arrange matching sweets in Candy Connection. Move them into rows, columns, or diagonals of at least three to make the line disappear and score points. Look for a move that makes another set easier to complete after the board changes.

pages.title: City Coach Bus Game
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Drive a passenger bus in City Coach Bus Game. Use the arrow keys to steer to bus stations, pick up passengers, and deliver them to their stops. Follow the routes through the city and onto highways while keeping the larger vehicle under control.

pages.title: Flappy Ball
pages.creator: Avabucks
pages.description: Keep the flapping character in the air in Flappy Ball. Tap to lift it toward the next opening, then let it fall when you need to line up lower. Time the taps to avoid the obstacles and see how far you can get.

pages.title: Uphill Mountain Jeep Drive 2k20
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Drive a jeep through mountain courses in Uphill Mountain Jeep Drive 2k20. Follow the checkpoints along narrow routes and slow down before turns that leave little room to steer. Check the road ahead for other vehicles before you accelerate onto the next stretch.

pages.title: 2021 UK Porsche 911 Turbo S Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble pictures of a Porsche 911 Turbo S in 2021 UK Porsche 911 Turbo S Puzzle. Choose from six images and solve one with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the car's shape and background details to work out which pieces belong together.

pages.title: Fashion Competition
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Prepare a contestant for the judges in Fashion Competition. Start with facial care, then choose makeup and a hairstyle before dressing her for the contest. Put the outfit and makeover together so the finished look is ready to be judged.

pages.title: Incredible Water Surfing : Car Racing Game 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive a sports car across water in Incredible Water Surfing : Car Racing Game 3D. Steer from the shore onto the water and follow the checkpoints to the finish. Look for the next marker as you turn so you can stay on the course even when there is no road underneath.

pages.title: Up Hill Free Driving
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Drive a jeep taxi in Up Hill Free Driving. Look for passengers, pick them up, and take them to their destinations. Watch the traffic and give yourself room to steer on the uphill parts of the route as you work through the city.

pages.title: Hanger 2 HTML5 Censored
pages.creator: A Small Game
pages.description: Swing a ragdoll through Hanger 2 HTML5 Censored. Time when you attach and release the rope so you can get past buzz saws and other hazards without losing too many body parts. Collect coins to unlock characters and improve them between runs.

pages.title: Car Arena Fight
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Crash into rival cars in Car Arena Fight. Build up speed before a hit and watch how each collision damages the vehicles. Keep track of the other drivers and use the space in the arena to get a clear run at your next target.

pages.title: Baby Panda Care
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Look after a baby panda in Baby Panda Care. Help at mealtime and work through the other activities as the panda's needs change. Use the items shown in each scene and watch the panda's reactions as you take on the caregiver's role.

pages.title: Boat Simulator 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take four kinds of watercraft out in Boat Simulator 2. Explore two landscapes, switch vessels to see how they handle, and change the camera to get another view. When you choose the submarine, use its depth slider to dive or return to the surface.

pages.title: Gold Digger Jack
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Drop a rope-mounted grabber into the ground in Gold Digger Jack. Wait for it to point toward the resource you want, then send it down to catch the object in its path. Judge the angle before releasing it so the hook brings up your target.

pages.title: Big Pizza Delivery Boy Simulator Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Ride a delivery motorcycle around town in Big Pizza Delivery Boy Simulator Game. Take pizza orders and follow the route to each customer's drop-off. Watch where the road leads as you go from one address to the next.

pages.title: Chibi Hero Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Guide the hero across a platforming world in Chibi Hero Adventure. Jump into blocks from below to shake out coins and throw steel stars at skeletons and zombies. Watch for the next landing while keeping a clear line for your only weapon.

pages.title: Logical Journey
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Collect every apple before leaving a level in Logical Journey. Push boxes out of the way, break them when needed, or use them to help you get past obstacles. Plan which boxes to move first so you can reach the apples while avoiding enemies.

pages.title: 1024 COLORFUL
pages.creator: kalem
pages.description: Combine matching numbers in 1024 COLORFUL and try to make 1024. Use the arrow keys to direct your moves and look at what can combine before sending the next number into place. Keep room available for the tiles you still need.

pages.title: Nonograms Valentines Day
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Use the row and column clues in Nonograms Valentines Day to uncover hidden hearts. Mark the spaces you have ruled out so you can see which ones still need checking. Work through 90 puzzles, earn stars, and collect gifts tied to achievements.

pages.title: Circle Crush
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Place colored circles into the grid in Circle Crush. Make a row, column, or diagonal of circles that share a color to clear the line. Check which colors the next piece adds and look for an arrangement that leaves space for later moves.

pages.title: The Fire of Fenix
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Fly through obstacles and fire at enemies in The Fire of Fenix. Pick up coins when you have a clear route to them and use your fire attacks to deal with threats ahead. Keep an eye on the hazards while lining up the next shot.

pages.title: Poly Art 3D
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Turn a cloud of fragments in Poly Art 3D until the pieces form a recognizable figure. Rotate it in different directions and watch where parts start to line up. Make smaller adjustments as the picture begins to come into view.

pages.title: Mega Pizza
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Build pizzas to order in Mega Pizza. Check what each customer wants, then add ingredients such as tomato or pepperoni to the dough. Pay attention to the order of the toppings and work quickly enough to serve the pizza while the customer is still waiting.

pages.title: Police Crime City Simulator Police Car Driving
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Patrol Miami as a police officer in Police Crime City Simulator Police Car Driving. Take the police car into the streets and pursue the gang as it moves through the city. Watch the traffic and keep the suspect in sight while you drive.

pages.title: Block Pixel Cop
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fight infected cops to survive in Block Pixel Cop. Move through the blocky world, switch weapons as threats change, and zoom in when you need a clearer shot. Use jumps and crouches to change your position while you look for a way past the next group.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Rescue Little Fluffy's family in Sweet Candy Mania. Shoot candies and match their colors to clear paths through the levels. Look for ways around the obstacles and collect the items you need to get farther across the Candy Planet.

pages.title: Fun Run Race 2 : Multiplayer
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Race through obstacle courses in Fun Run Race 2 : Multiplayer. Watch the hurdles and choose when to move so you can get through without falling behind. Make it past each obstacle and reach the finish ahead of your opponents.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Royal Bath
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Give Hazel a spa day in Baby Hazel Royal Bath. Start with a massage, then help her through the chocolate soak, milk bath, and shower. Finish the routine by choosing a costume and accessories for Hazel to wear afterward.

pages.title: Rescue Cut
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Free the character from each room in Rescue Cut by cutting ropes in the right order. Look at what will fall or move after each cut. Use the mechanisms to open a way to the exit while keeping the character clear of danger.

pages.title: Desert Car Race
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Drive through the desert in Desert Car Race and try for a quick finish. Collect coins and stars to add to your points while steering through the course. See how well you can balance the pickups with your finish time across 15 levels.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Put together pictures of Moscow in Jigsaw Puzzle. Choose a grid size to set the challenge, then work through the scattered pieces to rebuild the scene. Start with a detail you can recognize and use it to place the surrounding pieces.

pages.title: Supercars Parking
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Drive a Lamborghini through the parking courses in Supercars Parking. Collect three stars to reveal your spot, then line the car up to pull in. Ten layouts test different approaches, including front-in, reverse, and parallel parking.

pages.title: Mandala Coloring Book
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Choose a mandala and fill its sections with color in Mandala Coloring Book. Try repeating colors around the design to bring out the symmetry, or give neighboring sections contrasting shades. Switch drawings when you want to work with a different pattern.

pages.title: Burger Challenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Grab burgers from a spinning tray in Burger Challenge. Time your reach for the middle of a burger and try to be the first to collect five. Watch for the plus-one and minus-one items that can change your score. Play against the computer or a friend.

pages.title: Zombie Typer
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Type the words on screen to attack the undead in Zombie Typer. Keep your spelling accurate so the shots count and move on to the next word as another zombie approaches. See how many enemies you can stop as you build up your score.

pages.title: Ball Adventures
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a ball through ten 3D levels in Ball Adventures. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and use Left Shift to activate a power-up. Look ahead before jumping so you can guide the ball toward a safe landing.

pages.title: Fish Eat Grow Big
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Start as a small fish in Fish Eat Grow Big and eat smaller fish to grow. Keep clear of anything bigger than you while you look for something you can swallow. Pick your fish and add other players if you want to compete on the same play area.

pages.title: Stunt Planes
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Fly through hoops in Stunt Planes and use the booster to score more points. Line up the plane before you accelerate so you have a clear shot through the opening. Adjust your approach as the next set of hoops comes into view.

pages.title: Colour Text Challeenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Look at the word and the ink color in Colour Text Challeenge. Answer yes when the word names the color it appears in, or no when the two differ. Pay attention to both parts of the prompt as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: Unblock It
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slide wooden blocks aside in Unblock It to make an exit for the blue block. Think about what each piece is blocking before you move it. Try to clear the path in fewer moves across 24 levels, and use a hint when you cannot see the next step.

pages.title: Halloween Horror Massacre
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Chop wood for the furnace in Halloween Horror Massacre. Switch sides when a branch approaches so you can keep cutting without getting hit. Keep up the rhythm as the trunk comes down, and unlock more characters and earn medals as you play.

pages.title: Moto X3M Bike Race Game
pages.creator: MadPuffers
pages.description: Race a motorcycle through obstacle courses in Moto X3M Bike Race Game. Use the arrows to accelerate and balance the bike over jumps, and press Space to return to the last checkpoint after a crash. Work through 25 courses and try to cut your finish time.

pages.title: Fury Dash
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap groups of at least three diamonds to clear them in Fury Dash. Keep finding groups quickly to trigger Fury mode and use its powers to raise your score. Check the size of each cluster before tapping, since a smaller group stays on the board.

pages.title: Blocky Gun Paintball
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Choose the red or blue team in Blocky Gun Paintball. Fight other players across ten maps in a 3D multiplayer shooter. Use the layout to find a firing position and keep track of where the opposing team is moving as you try to help your side win.

pages.title: 1 Click 1 Line 1 Pop
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Line up matching creatures in 1 Click 1 Line 1 Pop to make them burst. Look at the nearby creatures before choosing a move, and watch which ones are still needed for the level objective. Keep setting up matches until you meet the target.

pages.title: Princesses & Pets Photo Contest
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Help Rapunzel and Ariel show off their pets in Princesses & Pets Photo Contest. Prepare each princess and her animal for a selfie, then see which picture gets more likes. Choose how each photo should look before sending it into the contest.

pages.title: Go Robots 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Get both robots to safety in Go Robots 1. Click objects to change what is in their way, then click a robot to send it moving. Figure out how the unusual gravity affects each route and watch for hostile robots across 25 stages.

pages.title: Mr. Journey Fox
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Help a fox reach the temple gates in Mr. Journey Fox. Drag objects into the level to set up a path that takes him to the gems. Make sure the route also reaches the key, which opens the exit so you can finish the stage.

pages.title: Cars Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color three different car drawings in Cars Coloring. Pick a color and click or tap the part of the car you want to paint. Try one shade for the body and another for details, then switch pictures when you want to design another car.

pages.title: Princesses Nails Salon
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style the sisters' nails in Princesses Nails Salon. Choose colors and nail designs, then put the parts of the manicure together. Try another color combination to give each sister a look of her own before finishing the salon visit.

pages.title: Lights
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Turn pieces of wire in Lights to connect every bulb to the power source. Follow the line from the source and look for breaks as you rotate pieces into place. Complete the circuit quickly if you want to earn more points.

pages.title: Hex Flight Racer
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Steer a futuristic jet car through bends in Hex Flight Racer. Use boosters for extra speed, but keep the car clear of the rails because impacts cause damage. Time your boosts for stretches you can handle and try to set a better record.

pages.title: Mutton Biryani: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Follow Sara's recipe in Mutton Biryani: Sara's Cooking Class. Work through the kitchen steps to prepare the spiced rice and mutton dish from India. Check what Sara asks for at each step and gather the right ingredients or tools before moving on.

pages.title: Ninja Room Escape
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Search a locked ninja's room in Ninja Room Escape. Look for objects and clues that could help open a way out. Check the room again when you find a new item, since something that looked unrelated may have a use once you know what to do with it.

pages.title: My Fashion Day Dress Up
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Choose a fashionable outfit in My Fashion Day Dress Up. Look through the dresses on offer and try out different pieces to see which style you prefer. Put together a look for the fashionista based on the colors and shapes you like.
